# Velair 1.9.0-beta.10

## ✨ Added

- Optional weekly Room Assist sensor schedules, with a default reference and overnight periods. Choose **Fixed sensor** or **By schedule** beside the Room Assist title; only the selected setup is shown in a compact editor with visible field explanations and detailed help where needed. Both configurations are retained when switching, mode changes use Save/Cancel, and the main Room Assist switch controls assistance. Thanks to **@mperone** for suggesting [issue #69](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/69).
- Optional Comfort backup sensors for temperature and humidity. Enable each reading independently to use its identified default source when the selected sensor is unavailable, then return to the selected sensor on recovery. Backups start disabled, and choosing the default source clears its backup option. Thanks to **@scastiello** for reporting [issue #71](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/71).

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Keep Room Assist and Comfort help messages fully opaque while inactive controls and unavailable readings remain dimmed.
- Fixed decimal temperature entry in the Climate card's Boost form, including both native range limits. Points and commas remain editable, incomplete values cannot be applied, and device steps, limits, range ordering and keyboard increments stay enforced. This extends beta.9's editor correction to the card's separate Boost form. Thanks to **@fuzzy01** for reporting [issue #68](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/68).
- Room Assist now calculates the final scalar or range target before applying a schedule block, avoiding an intermediate nominal-temperature command. Heating, cooling, block options and temperature-only behavior retain their existing meaning.
- Velair now detects accepted climate commands whose requested mode or setpoint is not reported and makes up to two background recovery attempts for the affected climate. Other independent climates continue without waiting or receiving duplicate commands. Retries use the current intention; obsolete pending work is cancelled.

## 🚀 Improved

- Diagnostics distinguishes commands accepted by Home Assistant from reported-setpoint confirmation, successful recovery and exhausted attempts. Matching delayed reports confirm through the existing listener without starting a recovery worker.
- Comfort groups backup controls into compact temperature and humidity rows. Its reading-quality explanation keeps the complete messages in a collapsible information panel beside the data sources.
- Updated the new Diagnostics and Comfort labels, and the Diagnostics, resilient-delivery and Comfort guides in all nine maintained non-English languages.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.9](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.9). Portable exports now use model 26 to include sensor schedules; older exports remain importable. Keep a backup made with the previous version for downgrading.
- Sensor references change at their configured time; this beta does not precondition across a reference change. External sensor readings must be available separately in Home Assistant. Real Home Assistant/Companion validation remains pending and will be performed by the maintainer. Synthetic browser previews do not replace that test.
- Reported-setpoint confirmation does not prove physical equipment operation. Installation-level recovery and physical iOS keyboard/Companion behavior still need validation. These changes do not establish that the reported installation's delivery issue is resolved.
- Guide translations remain identified as AI-assisted, without qualified human linguistic review. Please report wording or terminology issues.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
